economic_thesis: Relative trends persist when information and inventory adjustment diffuse across contracts, but continuation is weakest when positioning is already expensive. A fixed blend of medium- and short-horizon per-symbol trend ranks, penalized by realized funding rank, should hold uncrowded leaders long and crowded laggards short. Excluding the highest-volatility fifth and using broad equal capped sleeves limits squeeze concentration without changing the signal.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Negative medium/short trend and high funding should place persistent laggards in the short sleeve, which must contribute positively; longs are restricted to lower-volatility relative survivors with uncrowded positioning.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Positive medium/short trend and low funding should place persistent leaders in the long sleeve, which must contribute positively; shorts target crowded relative laggards rather than broad beta.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Medium and fast trend ranks weaken or disagree, so realized funding de-crowding and equal side budgets must preserve positive combined return without disabling either sleeve.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long the highest fixed composite ranks among the lower-volatility four fifths; long exposure remains material and must be positive in bull.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the lowest fixed composite ranks among the lower-volatility four fifths; short exposure remains material and must be positive in bear.
expected_regime_roles.stress: The highest-volatility fifth is excluded, requested gross is 0.60, and names are capped at 0.04. These structural limits reduce concentration but do not assert crisis alpha; stress and drawdown remain hard empirical gates.

falsifier: Stop the initial UTC family before parameter or risk study if the exact no-control reference is insolvent or incomplete; has nonpositive annualized return, net Sharpe, or doubled-cost Sharpe; has fewer than four profitable folds; has nonpositive bull, bear, or chop return; fails long-bull or short-bear attribution; or has nonpositive pooled and four-of-six-fold next-holding-period score IC. Controls cannot rescue a failed core. Any champion must later pass every full development, multiplicity, concentration, and neighborhood gate.
mechanism: At a fixed three-day rebalance use exact closed 8h prices through t-8h and funding strictly before t. Compute 42-day trend skipping the latest two days, 14-day trend skipping the latest day, seven-day realized funding per day, and 30-day volatility. Exclude the highest-volatility fifth. Score each retained symbol as 0.50 medium-trend rank plus 0.30 fast-trend rank minus 0.20 funding rank. Long the top quarter and short the bottom quarter with equal broad weights, 0.30 budget per side, 0.04 cap, and at most 0.60 gross.
risk_policy_plan: Begin with the exact disabled no-control reference. Only after a solvent positive core may a 30-day 25 percent volatility target and preregistered 10/18/25 percent drawdown brake be evaluated as none, each individual, and combined at base and doubled costs. Position/time stops, turnover limits, side scaling, and same-boundary reentry remain disabled. Controls cannot create eligibility for failed alpha, regimes, sleeves, folds, or score IC.
selection_metric: Require all non-compensatory gates and causal score-IC signs first; then lexicographically maximize positive-fold count, worst-regime Sharpe, worst-fold Sharpe, doubled-cost Sharpe, median-fold Sharpe, aggregate Sharpe, and Calmar; then minimize drawdown and turnover, with bytewise candidate_id last. Require at least seven of nine profitable declared neighbors and neighbor median Sharpe at least 0.50.
